summary.text: Nicole Clowney is serving her fourth term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 21, which includes portions of Washington County.

paragraphs.text: She teaches at the University of Arkansas at Fayetteville and graduated with a B.A. in classics from the University of Chicago and a J.D. from Yale University.
She lives in Fayetteville with her husband and two children.
The legislature's member page lists her as House Minority Party Whip for 2026.
